Spin-to-win: grant tickets for completed purchases.
enabled turn purchase-sourced grants on. SHIPS OFF. Switching this on is what makes spin-to-win purchase -> chance -> prize; get sign-off and consider a free alternative method of entry first. tickets how many spins one qualifying purchase earns. min_spend net total a purchase must reach to earn anything. 0 means any non-refund sale qualifies. max_age_days ignore purchases older than this. The importer runs in bulk and has been days behind; without this a catch-up run mints a ticket for every backdated receipt at once.
